judge.rationale: The candidate makes the exact same production code change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` as the reference, moving `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including updating the spec with clear guidance on what `afterSession` can assume when `beforeSession` fails, updating the spec line-number links across all affected spec files, and adding a comprehensive migration note to `CHANGELOG.md`. The unit test added to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` is even slightly more thorough than the reference's by also verifying that intermediate hooks (`beforeUserInput`, `beforeModelResponse`, `afterModelResponse`) are skipped. The only minor difference from the reference is the inclusion of the harness `.lore/dod.md` file and an additional acceptance test file.
